The 0005, 0009, 0016, 0017, 0019, 0022, 0026 and 0027 r-7 amendment subsections and their index markers are Active. No (Proposed, r-7) marker remains. The Trait boundary sentence is rewritten.

sc-decision-schema is publish_order 2 and later crates are shifted to 10. release/publish-artifacts.toml carries it. scripts/sc-publish-dry-run.sh builds its package list from the manifest data (line 149), so it needs no literal edit.
Text matches the sprint doc. allowed_dependencies is sc-agent-types, serde and serde_json. Every dependent manifest gains the edge, and sc-agent-http forbids it.

notes:
Review basis and limits. The branch ref resolves to 94972978d9e6, matching the requested commit 9497297, and the worktree HEAD is refs/heads/sprint/r-7-decision-schema. I had no shell, so I could not run git diff, cargo or the sc-boundary validator, and I did not diff against base 0d0ebc1. Everything below comes from reading files and grepping.

Sprint adrs list: every id resolves to an Active ADR, the only Proposed ids being the landing-sprint ADRs 0030 and 0031, which the policy exception allows. The flips are present on the branch. I did not recompute the expected list in full, so I may have missed an ADR the sprint should name.

Data-only crate: sc-decision-schema src has no fs, process, net, io, logging or ureq use. Its dependencies are sc-agent-types with default-features = false, plus serde and serde_json. sc-agent-types no longer has the judge or test-util features, and its source tree no longer holds the moved judge.rs, payload.rs, test_util.rs or the old tests.

Other structural checks: no sc_agent_types import of a moved type remains in crates. No Sha256Digest::of( call remains. The judge signature takes &SendTrace. send_with_busy_retry and send_and_parse take a required SendTrace. HAIKU_MODEL, LUNA_MODEL and the jev.toml model key are gone. The registry factory type is fn(ResolvedApiKey, &ModelAliases). UnknownModel has a private field and is built only in FromStr. check.toml [models] is remapped to CONFIG_INVALID. The release path handled the CPR-014 publish gate as the sprint says: the manifest only changed, nothing was published.

RULE-ADR-AWAIT-MUTEX: there is no .await or async fn anywhere in crates, so no std::sync::Mutex guard can span an await.

Minor observation, not a finding: docs/architecture.md:374, an r-1-era note under ADR-SAG-0022, still names sc_agent_types::test_util::MockJudgeBackend. It is historical text that the Active r-7 amendment at :430 supersedes, so I left it.

One item for req-qa rather than me: the llm::v1::parse_output rustdoc says confidence and probabilities must be in [0, 1], while the sprint says the parse_answers checks move unchanged. I could not diff the old code to confirm.
